name: Three Finger Show Desktop
description:
Adds a touchpad gesture that GNOME does not provide: show the desktop with a 3-finger swipe down on the normal desktop (Wayland, GNOME 50).

* Swipe down (top of touchpad toward bottom): minimize all windows on the current workspace to show the desktop; swipe down again to restore them
* Swipe up is unchanged: this extension only observes touchpad events and never blocks GNOME, so the stock 3-finger up gesture still opens Overview and the app grid
* No panel icon and no Quick Settings entry
